profiles.notes: Checked 2026-11-09 against https://livekit.io/pricing and https://docs.livekit.io/deploy/admin/quotas-and-limits/. LiveKit Cloud Build plan, $0 a month, no credit card: 100 participants connected at once (agents and end users), 5,000 WebRTC participant minutes a month and 50 GB downstream data transfer a month included. On Build the included allowance is a hard cap: new requests fail after it is used, with no overage charge. Server API limit 1,000 requests per minute. Standard data processing addendum. The open source media server can be self-hosted instead (pricing page); self-hosting is not profiled here.

Checked 2026-11-09 against https://livekit.io/pricing. LiveKit Cloud Ship plan, starting at $50 a month: 1,000 participants connected at once, 150,000 WebRTC participant minutes included then $0.0005 per minute, 250 GB downstream data included then $0.12 per GB. Usage above the allowance is billed.

Checked 2026-11-09 against https://livekit.io/pricing. LiveKit Cloud Scale plan, starting at $500 a month: 5,000 participants connected at once, 1.5 million WebRTC participant minutes included then $0.0004 per minute, 3 TB downstream data included then $0.10 per GB; adds region pinning and role-based access. Enterprise is custom and not profiled.

notes: Local checks need no account and contact no provider. Deployment needs LiveKit credentials supplied by reference. Limits come only from the two LiveKit pages named in the profile notes; per-day request and stored-data limits do not apply to media and are omitted.
